quotes.text: "Should not generate malformed cell warnings for unescaped parentheses"

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: consumeBlock tracks structural depth outside cell parentheses and returns null for an unterminated block. Its caller warns and advances; missing key/value references are dropped with warnings. Escaped closing parentheses are converted before row parsing. The Received-style regression checks one exact preserved value and zero malformed-cell warnings. Those bounds do not prove lossless recovery, arbitrary nested cells or crash immunity. No runtime or fuzz test ran.
title: Mork block recovery advances the cursor but does not certify every malformed input
